description:
Piyyuṭim by Samuel the Third, pertaining to Parashat Vayeḥi (Genesis 47:28-50:26). F. 2r contains most of the ofan; f. 2v contains the meʾora and the first part of the ahava; f. 1r contains the final two lines of the מי כמוך, all of the י‫׳ מלכנו‬, and most of the ועד מתי, which concludes on f. 1v. 

F. 1v contains a colophon giving the name of the copyist (Avraham b. Aharon) and the date and place of completion of the copy (Cairo, Thursday, 14 Av 1406 of the Seleucid Era (= 1095 CE)).

(Information from CUDL.)
